body.x: BARCELONA, Spain (AVING Special Report on 'Mobile World Congress 2011') -- <Visual News> An attempt that smartphone invades the area of PC is being tried in Spain.
Motorola Mobility(www.motorola.com) introduced 'ARTRIX', the first smartphone which invaded the area of PC at MWC 2011 held in Barcelona, Spain from February 14(local time).
ARTRIX already has been unveiled at CES 2011 in Las Vegas, USA last month and it is still the only smartphone which can be used as PC, so many visitors are paying attention.
(Picture: 'ARTRIX' can be used as laptop when connected to 'Laptop Dock')
Especially 'Laptop Dock' is making a sensation. It offers only dock to put ARTRIX with the appearance of the existing laptop.

At the booth, there are few demonstrations such as ARTRIX which has been changed into laptop, general computing such as internet surfing and writing documents through 'Firefox' and applications of ARTRIX on large screen.

Motorola also introduced 'Desk Dock' connectable with general LCD monitor. If put ARTRIX in it of general recharging dock type, you can do computing as same as general desktop computing by using LCD monitor, keyboard and mouse which are connected with Desk Dock.

According to an official of Motorola Mobility, this function is possible because ARTRIX with dual core processor offers computing conditions with PC quality. He can't even guess the limitation, the performance of smartphone will be stronger and stronger.
Motorola is exhibiting tablet 'XOOM' and smartphone 'ARTRIX' as major models at MWC 2011 and is giving strong impression by decorating its booth with red and black color.
(Picture: He is demonstrating computing as same as desktop's by connecting 'ARTRIX' with 'Desk Dock')
